# Foodies Kodad

> Foodies is a family-friendly restaurant and bakery located in Kodad, Telangana. We offer fresh cakes, bakery favourites, fast food, Chinese dishes, biryani, and beverages.

Developer: amarachintha akhil (amarachinthaakhil@gmail.com)

## Location
Kodad Main Road, beside Ranga Theater, Kodad, Telangana 508206.
Open Monday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

## Features
- Dine-in, Takeaway, Delivery, Drive-through
- Custom birthday and anniversary cakes
- Online menu and table booking
- Order via WhatsApp or Tizola

## Links
- [Home Page](https://foodieskodad.com/): Main page with interactive menu, gallery, and reviews.
